# 💬 Welcome to Secure Dialer GitHub Discussions!

Welcome to the **Secure Dialer** community forum! This is a public space for users, privacy enthusiasts, Android developers, and custom ROM testers to connect, ask questions, share setups, and discuss the future of private mobile communications.

---

## 📂 Discussion Categories

To keep discussions structured and easy to search, please select the category that best matches your topic:

### 💡 [Feature Ideas & Feedback](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/discussions/categories/ideas)
Have an idea for improving the T9 dialpad, call history, or offline call screening? 
* Post your feature ideas here.
* Upvote proposals submitted by other community members!

### ❓ [Q&A & Usage Support](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/discussions/categories/q-a)
Need help setting Secure Dialer as your default phone app, configuring call screening, or managing local contacts?
* Search existing questions before posting.
* Mark accepted answers when your question is resolved!

### 📱 [Custom ROMs & Device Setups](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)
Using Secure Dialer on **GrapheneOS, CalyxOS, LineageOS, e/OS**, or OEM devices (Samsung Knox, Pixel, Xiaomi)?
* Share your configuration tips, permission setups, and battery optimization tweaks.
* Help fellow users get the best experience on custom operating systems.

### 💬 [General Discussion](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/discussions/categories/general)
General chat about Android mobile security, zero-internet permissions, open-source software, and digital privacy.

### 📢 [Announcements](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/discussions/categories/announcements) *(Maintainer Only)*
Official project updates, major release announcements, and development news.

---

## 📜 Community Rules & Guidelines

1. **Be Respectful & Welcoming:** Follow our **[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)** at all times.
2. **Search Before Posting:** Use the GitHub search bar to see if your topic or question has already been addressed.
3. **No Support Guarantees:** Community discussions are maintained by volunteers and the maintainer on a best-effort basis.
4. **Report Bugs via Issue Forms:** If you encountered a reproducible bug, please use our interactive **[Bug Report Form](https://github.com/Secure-Phone-apps/Secure-Dialer/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)** instead of opening a discussion thread.
